limitations: Validation tuning evidence only: no promotion, test gate, live-policy or win-rate claim.

Brier uses all usable candidate Bernoulli trials, not just complete ranking decisions. Reference report lacks trial predictions: paired Brier CI unavailable; no subtraction of independent CI endpoints.
Record identities and evaluation values match, but report records omit action payloads and raw world IDs.
Regret uses noisy finite-sample candidate maxima, not a legal-action oracle.
Retained auxiliary head rows have zero supervised gradients but share the trunk and AdamW weight decay; outputs are untrained and not interpreted.
conclusion: No demonstrated choice-value improvement: matched 95% seed-bootstrap interval includes zero; retain original and do not promote on validation.
